target_customer: Engineering, product and technical writing teams at API companies, mostly fintech, with 20 or more developers
problem: API documentation is time consuming to build and maintain and existing tools are limiting. Theneo generates and keeps interactive Stripe like docs up to date, using AI.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with free tier and paid plans (prices not published on homepage)
product_category: API documentation and developer portal platform

founders.name: Ana Robakidze
founders.background_notes: Caucasus Business Week says she worked at several US tech companies, most recently as Head of Engineering where she helped integrate hundreds of APIs; TechCrunch says she headed an engineering team. Employers are not named.

founders.name: Maria Doliashvili
founders.background_notes: Named as a co-founder by Caucasus Business Week; the YC page lists only Robakidze.

competitors.name: Stoplight
competitors.what: API design and documentation platform with visual OpenAPI editor
competitors.funding_then: $11 million follow on round announced 2021-02-08 after a $6 million Series A in January 2020

competitors.name: ReadMe
competitors.what: API documentation and developer metrics hub
competitors.funding_then: $9 million Series A led by Accel, August 2019

technical_complexity.rationale: Rendering docs from OpenAPI specs with editors and integrations is standard engineering; AI generation was added on top using existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals existed, docs are generated from open specs, and switching costs are low until a team builds a portal on top.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals kept building; a search result reports SmartBear bought Stoplight in 2023. Atlassian Ventures invested in Theneo in November 2023 after an Atlassian Compass integration.

market_need_then: The founder was frustrated by time consuming documentation tools (TechCrunch, October 2022). Caucasus Business Week reports the beta in August 2021 spread by word of mouth to over 1,000 companies and developers.

branding.domain_note: theneo.io, an .io domain (acquisition details not found)

identity.logo: Updated logo with new colors and typography in a redesign announced during Product Hunt launch week (date not seen)
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and punchy, for example 'Docs that humans and agents ship together'

branding.brand_signature: 'Stripe like API docs in a few clicks' positioning
branding.community_and_virality: Showcased at TechCrunch Disrupt Battlefield 200 and Web Summit, Product Hunt launch week, GITA grant and Apps Challenge 2021 win.

brand_strength.rationale: Invented name with a strong positioning line, and conference press, but it is easily confused with Teneo or similar names and no community evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Theneo is active and says more than 18,000 companies use it, up from about 3,000 in October 2022, with customers such as Ticketmaster. Free sign up and word of mouth growth fit product led growth. Funding is small and inconsistently reported, and it has strategic backing from Atlassian Ventures since 2023. No acquisition, layoffs or shutdown were found; customer counts are self reported.
notes: Pre seed amounts conflict: TechCrunch (2022-10-19) says $1.5 million raised in the first year, while Caucasus Business Week says GEL 1.5 million (roughly a third of that in dollars), so amount_usd is left null. Aggregators give $949K (PitchBook), $500K (CB Insights), $3.9M total (Caplight), unverified. The November 2023 round amount is not stated on the company blog dated 2023-11-15; stage left as other because the source does not label it (Seedtable calls it seed). Founded year 2021 per Caucasus Business Week (beta Aug 2021); YC says 2022. The Stoplight and ReadMe entries come from search results (not opened); the SmartBear acquisition claim came from an aggregator snippet. The Caucasus Business Week article has no exact date.
